title: Shielded Roots
summary: Merkle roots of the shielded commitment trees that prove privacy balances updated correctly. Shielded transfers use commitments of the form c_m=H(tag||payload) with nullifiers n_f=H(sk||c_m||salt) to update these roots while hiding transaction amounts and participants from public view.

tagline: Allows privacy-preserving transactions while maintaining network auditability.
